# AstroMonk AI Guide

AstroMonk is a Dual-Engine Cosmic Intelligence application powered by advanced Vedic Astrological mathematics and state-of-the-art Large Language Models (Gemini & Groq).

## Services
- [Daily Horoscope](https://astro-monk.vercel.app/feature/daily)
- [Birth Chart / Kundli](https://astro-monk.vercel.app/feature/chart)
- [Ask the Cosmic Oracle](https://astro-monk.vercel.app/feature/ask)

## Technology
Built with React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Python, Flask, and JyotishGanit.
